title: mentha × verticillata var. moenchiana
intro: Mentha × verticillata var. moenchiana, commonly known as Bowles' Mint, is a hybrid species of mint, derived from the cross between Mentha × verticillata and Mentha requienii. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include relieving digestive issues, such as nausea and indigestion, as well as exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Bowles' Mint include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, helping to ease muscle cramps and spasms, and its carminative properties, which aid in relieving flatulence and bloating. The bioactive constituents of Bowles' Mint include essential oils, such as menthone and menthol, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
